name: @synclair/core
description: Synclair's machinery — the artifact modules (zod schemas, scan-on-write, read-on-read), scanners, checks, the running-app harness, the MCP server, and the clone lifecycle — behind one CLI. The template (hub UI, seed, judgment) stays vendored per repo; this package is the half that gets fixed by version bump. Boundary: docs/core-boundary.md.
